recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for current FHIR core; any discrepancy between Jira's applied-for metadata and the historical STU3 publication is historical and outside the current source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-13233 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, that originally asked to add a CareTeam endpoint but whose accepted resolution added telecom 0..* ContactPoint as a central contact detail for the care team.
initial_application: No repository commit explicitly mentions FHIR-13233. The current active CareTeam StructureDefinition contains CareTeam.telecom with committee note GF#13233, 0..* cardinality, ContactPoint type, and the accepted central-contact definition; git history shows that content carried into XML source during the 2021 source rework rather than through a separately traceable Jira-key commit.
additional_context: CareTeam is an active Patient Care resource in source/fhir.ini and is marked approved, so source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml is in current build scope. Published R4 and R5 profiles contain CareTeam.telecom with the same semantics, while the checked STU3 profile did not despite Jira applied-for metadata. Targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for this FHIR-core telecom/endpoint question.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already defines CareTeam.telecom and contains no CareTeam.endpoint element, matching the modified resolution.
